title: Rollcall snapshot
description: One stored scan, `<ROLLCALL_STORE_DIR>/<date>.json`. Facts only: states are derived from the policy when a report is built, so an old snapshot is re-read against the dates that applied on its day. Internal data: it holds app ids.

blobs.description: File name to the blob id last read, so an unchanged file is not fetched again.

upgrade_due.description: Due date of a pending forced image upgrade (Citadel export), or null. Optional: snapshots written before it existed have no key, and schema_version stays 1.

runtime_php.description: The PHP version in the running container, such as 8.3.14, when the image source reports it (a Citadel export), or null. Optional: snapshots written before it existed have no key, and schema_version stays 1.

runtime_httpd.description: The Apache httpd version in the running container, such as 2.4.62, when the image source reports it (a Citadel export), or null. Optional: snapshots written before it existed have no key, and schema_version stays 1.

booster_result.description: The result Booster recorded in the app's booster-hop.json, when the file is present and readable, or null. Optional: snapshots written before it existed have no key, and schema_version stays 1.

booster_version.description: The Booster version named in the app's booster-hop.json, when the record has one, or null. Optional: snapshots written before it existed have no key, and schema_version stays 1.

booster_at.description: When Booster finished the hop, from the app's booster-hop.json, or null. Optional: snapshots written before it existed have no key, and schema_version stays 1.

mysql56.description: The state of the app's MySQL 5.6 CI job from PROCTOR's mysql56-ci findings (held, missing, not_applicable or unknown), when a report says, or null. Optional: snapshots written before it existed have no key, and schema_version stays 1.
